title: Find the name and original release date of the oldest mythic rare card with
question: Find the name and original release date of the oldest mythic rare card with converted mana cost greater than 5 that has rulings mentioning 'triggered ability', is illustrated by an artist whose name starts with 'D', and is legal in the Legacy format.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_049", T4."XCL_112"
FROM cards AS T1
INNER JOIN sets AS T4 ON T1."XCL_063" = T4."XCL_099"
INNER JOIN rulings AS T2 ON T1."XCL_072" = T2."XCL_090"
INNER JOIN legalities AS T3 ON T1."XCL_072" = T3."XCL_086"
WHERE T1."XCL_059" = 'mythic'
  AND T1."XCL_011" > 5
  AND T2."XCL_089" LIKE '%triggered ability%'
  AND T1."XCL_002" LIKE 'D%'
  AND T3."XCL_084" = 'legacy'
ORDER BY T4."XCL_112" ASC
LIMIT 1

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_049", T1."XCL_004"
FROM cards AS T1
INNER JOIN rulings AS T2 ON T1."XCL_072" = T2."XCL_090"
INNER JOIN legalities AS T3 ON T1."XCL_072" = T3."XCL_086"
WHERE T1."XCL_059" = 'mythic'
  AND T1."XCL_014" > 5
  AND T2."XCL_089" LIKE '%triggered ability%'
  AND T1."XCL_002" LIKE 'D%'
  AND T3."XCL_084" = 'legacy'
ORDER BY T1."XCL_004" ASC
LIMIT 1

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT 
    c.XCL_002 AS name,
    s.XCL_112 AS original_release_date
FROM cards c
JOIN sets s ON c.XCL_015 = s.XCL_099
JOIN rulings r ON c.XCL_072 = r.XCL_090
JOIN legalities l ON c.XCL_072 = l.XCL_086
WHERE 
    c.XCL_006 = 'mythic rare'
    AND c.XCL_014 > 5
    AND r.XCL_089 LIKE '%triggered ability%'
    AND c.XCL_003 LIKE 'D%'
    AND l.XCL_085 = 'Legacy'
ORDER BY 
    s.XCL_112 ASC
LIMIT 1
